value.rationale: The claim identifies a meaningful and sharp error mode of a current quasi-static model reduction: every degree >=4 retains the correct threshold and leading critical decay yet reverses the sign of the subleading log correction. The rational coefficient gap measures a genuine failure of the fast nullcline to be invariant; it cannot be read off from the published first-order effective infection coefficient. This gives a motivated diagnostic of approximation quality at critical extinction.
